### Summary The default branch already hardened `.github/workflows/welcome.yml` against the issue(s) below, but **3** release branches still carry it. This proposes the same, minimal, scanner-verified fix for each. ### What's flagged (by [zizmor](https://github.com/woodruffw/zizmor)) - `excessive-permissions` — workflow/job granted broader `permissions` than needed Already resolved on the default branch in: - https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/commit/a5c4606a985471fbfc9e1128c4a2ddc6c0ef9a07 ### Affected release branches (3) - **`release-0.13.2`** (still present as of HEAD `aa80e2d6`) - **`release-0.13.1`** (still present as of HEAD `55215706`) - **`release-0.13.0`** (still present as of HEAD `abb8c353`) ### Suggested per-branch patches Each diff below was checked locally with **zizmor** and **actionlint**: the flagged finding(s) are cleared on the affected construct and no new lint or security findings are introduced. (Whitespace is normalized; only security-relevant lines change.)
release-0.13.2 — excessive-permissions File `.github/workflows/welcome.yml`; suggested edits: - + jobs.$J.permissions.pull-requests = 'write' ```diff --- a/.github/workflows/welcome.yml +++ b/.github/workflows/welcome.yml @@ -43,3 +43,5 @@ Please make sure you've read our [contributing guide](https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and we look forward to reviewing your pull request shortly ✨` }) + permissions: + pull-requests: write ```
release-0.13.1 — excessive-permissions File `.github/workflows/welcome.yml`; suggested edits: - + jobs.$J.permissions.pull-requests = 'write' ```diff --- a/.github/workflows/welcome.yml +++ b/.github/workflows/welcome.yml @@ -43,3 +43,5 @@ Please make sure you've read our [contributing guide](https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and we look forward to reviewing your pull request shortly ✨` }) + permissions: + pull-requests: write ```
release-0.13.0 — excessive-permissions File `.github/workflows/welcome.yml`; suggested edits: - + jobs.$J.permissions.pull-requests = 'write' ```diff --- a/.github/workflows/welcome.yml +++ b/.github/workflows/welcome.yml @@ -43,3 +43,5 @@ Please make sure you've read our [contributing guide](https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and we look forward to reviewing your pull request shortly ✨` }) + permissions: + pull-requests: write ```
--- *Happy to open pull requests instead if that's preferred.*
items.title: Backport workflow-hardening fix (excessive-permissions) to 3 release branches
